correctness.rationale: PBW monomials x^i y^j, 0<=i,j<3, give dim9 and J dim8 for xy=zeta yx. For any positive-degree f, a faithful matrix representation x->uD,y->vP over k[u,v]/(u^3,v^3), with DP=zeta PD, has char polynomial t^3 by root-of-unity conjugation and Cayley-Hamilton, so f^3=0 (including char2). Nonzero degree-one coefficient forces rank6 and rank(f^2)=3 by homogeneous block ranks. For f in J^2 the degree-two coefficient triple (a,b,c) controls Delta=b^2-zeta^2 ac and degree-one-to-degree-three 2x2 minor, yielding ranks 4 (Delta!=0) and 3 (Delta=0, triple!=0), squares ranks 1 and 0; lower J^3,J^4 strata give ranks2,1,0. PBW rank formulas determine all six listed Jordan partitions. The smooth nonzero quadratic cone has Q^2-1 finite-field points; multiplying by 3 higher coefficients yields exact counts. Nakayama says the nonzero principal right ideal fA of dimension r has (Q-1)Q^(r-1) generating elements; the stated ideal counts and total 3(Q^2+Q+1)+1 follow. Independently constructed exact 9x9 PBW left multiplication over GF7 and tested representative ranks/square ranks (6,3),(4,1),(3,0),(2,0),(1,0),(0,0). These spot checks do not replace the all-field algebra argument.

broader_coverage.reasoning: After translating yx=lambda xy with lambda=zeta^-1, the previous s=1+lambda+lambda^2=0 branch proves every radical cube zero. Its invariant is elementwise nilpotency index, not nine-dimensional multiplication-Jordan partitions nor principal right ideal counts; the latter do not follow just from f^3=0.

value.rationale: A complete exact multiplication-Jordan stratification of all eight-dimensional radical elements in a natural small quantum complete intersection, including smooth strata and principal RIGHT ideals, is a motivated algebraic invariant; it extends beyond the standard rank-one linear pencil and is not implied by knowing all elements are cubically nilpotent. The exact finite-field total and the matching-but-distinct modular commutative pattern provide useful structural comparison, not just table recomputation.

limitations: Target quantum algebra exists only with primitive cube root, hence finite Q≡1 mod3, char!=3.
The reduced geometry is not a claim about nonreduced determinantal scheme structures.
Prior module literature might contain other unindexed all-element classifications.
